date_note: CNN Brasil's article, dated 25 Nov, gives no earlier date for ZenoX's findings.
exec: Brazilian threat-intelligence firm ZenoX describes an organised fraud group targeting people in Brazil.
geo_basis: country as stated; no city named
impact: ZenoX says the total size of the leaked data available to the group is unknown.
plain: A Brazilian security firm says a fraud group has a platform to search stolen logins, pick victims and run scam campaigns across Brazil, with WhatsApp contacts and leaked card records.
summary: CNN Brasil reports that Brazilian threat-intelligence firm ZenoX linked a group called Plump Spider to a platform used to search stolen credentials, pick potential victims and coordinate fraud campaigns across Brazil. The article says the group holds WhatsApp contacts and leaked card records.
title: ZenoX says Plump Spider fraud group holds WhatsApp contacts and leaked card records

validation.note: Only CNN Brasil, relaying ZenoX's investigation, was read; ZenoX's own report was not found.

evidence.quote: um grupo de hackers brasileiros com quase 84 mil contatos de WhatsApp
e mais de 5,7 mil registros de cartões vazados para aplicar golpes digitais.
o grupo conta com cerca de dez operadores identificados pela análise da ZenoX.
